ops.text: Confirmed the full chain. (1) Host-side: bluebubbles VM process pid 2161 = 780 CPU-hours / 18.7 days uptime ≈ 1.74 cores continuous since boot; metal VM 1.5%, hermes VM 0.4%. (2) In-guest: one coreaudiod thread at 39.4% (97min STIME + 74min UTIME over 7.3h — spinning its entire life; the daemon restarted 7h ago and re-entered the spin, so it's not instance-specific), two launchd threads ~37% each. (3) Log flood: launchd 4127 lines/5min ('failed lookup: com.apple.BTAudioHALPlugin.xpc requestor coreaudiod' + 'com.apple.bluetooth.xpc requestor audiomxd', plus 'Flushed N logs [limit: 20]' — launchd is throttling, so the true lookup rate far exceeds the visible ~1.7/s). (4) Origin: commit 9c1cecb 'bluebubbles: debloat Continuity daemons driving the airportd CoreWLAN storm' added com.apple.bluetoothd to debloat.bluebubbles (machines.json:341); metal does NOT debloat bluetoothd and is quiet. Root cause: coreaudiod's Bluetooth HAL plugin and audiomxd retry their bluetoothd-provided XPC services in a tight no-backoff loop when bluetoothd is disabled. Next: live-test disabling com.apple.audio.coreaudiod + audiomxd in the guest, measure CPU drop, verify BlueBubbles health.
